title: Teamspeak

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Moderators are allowed to go into team channels, but only under extreme cases where there's a disturbance and they need to solve a conflict. However, considering it's basically an unregulated channel and it can compare to the Nightclub, I don't really see a reason to have them allowed to join. Don't think there's ever been a dispute.

Media are allowed so they can stream from a team's perspective, though. I think this should only be allowed during tournament play, so I'd restrict that permission until the time comes. If there's media abuse, there's a 99% chance that alone would demote them.

replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body:
As Iron said here:

"I have done every email in the support box, so unless it was in the last 3 days its been handled ... from now on having 10 seniors makes us a lot more efficient. We are doing them quite regularly now!"

@OP Also Refs and Officials have perms to join any team channels. If you do find one of them joining a channel unnecessarily, ask them to leave, and they should. If they don't get some screenshots and write to support@avicus.net, or report it to a Senior.
